NMBL / Nimbus Logistics: public news roundup (Priya, 2026-10-23). Public sources only: the press release, the call, sell-side notes. Nothing from the desk or the deal side.

- Nimbus Logistics reported Q3 2026 results on 2026-10-22: revenue $1.21bn, down 3% year over year; adjusted EBITDA $36m.
- Management cut full-year revenue guidance to $4.8-4.9bn, from $5.0bn, citing soft freight volumes.
- On the call the CEO said the Memphis hub automation project is on budget and finishes in Q2 2027.
- Shares fell 7% on 2026-10-22 to close at $28.88.
- One sell-side analyst cut NMBL to Hold with a $33 price target on 2026-10-22.
- Management declined to comment on M&A when asked on the call. No public report of a sale process.

my take: guidance cut was mostly priced in, the automation spend is the real story for 2027
